obligations.requirement: Do not exceed 0.02 grains per dry standard cubic foot of particulate matter emissions from Stack S-1.
Do not exceed 24.5 tons of VOC emissions in any rolling 12-month period.
Conduct a performance (stack) test on Stack S-1 using EPA Method 5 and submit results within 30 days of the test.
Inspect the wet scrubber on the coating line and record the pressure drop and liquid flow rate.
Calibrate the continuous opacity monitor annually, no later than the anniversary of the permit issue date.
obligations.due_rule: no later than the anniversary of the permit issue date

obligations.requirement: Keep a monthly log of coating usage, VOC content of each coating, and calculated VOC emissions.
obligations.due_rule: by the 10th day of the following month

obligations.requirement: Retain all records required by this permit on site for five years and make them available to the Department on request.
Submit an annual emissions inventory report to the Department by March 1 of each year, covering the previous calendar year.
Submit a semi-annual monitoring report by July 31 and January 31, summarizing all deviations from permit conditions.
Notify the Department by telephone within 24 hours of any malfunction that causes emissions to exceed a limit in Section 1, and in writing within 7 days.
obligations.due_rule: within 24 hours by telephone, within 7 days in writing

obligations.requirement: The Environmental Manager is the responsible party for all notifications under this section.
Apply for renewal at least 180 days before the expiration date.
obligations.due_rule: at least 180 days before the expiration date

obligations.requirement: Obtain prior written approval for any change in process equipment that could increase emissions.
